intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one random, complex, photorealistic keyword-reflection test centered on a diamond-shaped figure, independently realized as a body silhouette whose broadest contour is through the central torso and waist, with visibly narrower shoulders and hips and comparatively slimmer limbs, inside a desert radio-astronomy calibration scene.

Create a photorealistic environmental editorial photograph in a desert radio-astronomy array during a windborne ochre dust gust. One unmistakably adult woman in her early thirties, fully clothed in a fitted sand-colored technical coverall, sealed boots, gloves, and protective goggles resting above her eyes, works beside an open weatherproof receiver cabinet. Her full-body silhouette shows the broadest contour through the central torso and waist, visibly narrower shoulders and hips, and comparatively slimmer arms and legs, creating a clear diamond-shaped figure. She turns a knurled calibration dial inside the cabinet with one gloved hand while holding a compact spectrum analyzer with a visible live waveform in the other. Large white parabolic dishes recede across the desert behind her, their edges softened by moving dust. The attached image guides her facial appearance; her body geometry follows the specified silhouette. Prioritize an unobstructed three-quarter full-body view, credible hand-to-dial contact, readable scientific equipment, natural fabric tension, and crisp directional late-afternoon light cutting through airborne dust.
